objective: Reduce unnecessary virgin plastic production, hazardous exposure, leakage, and life-cycle water burden while preserving health, food, infrastructure, and safety services.
governance_principles: Define essentiality and service performance before setting a ban or material target.
Require chemical, additive, recycled-content, and intentionally added PFAS disclosure.
Use prevention, reuse, and safe design before relying on downstream recovery.
Make producers fund collection, verified processing, litter prevention, and public reporting.
Protect workers and fence-line communities during both current production and replacement manufacturing.
Assess water quantity, quality, and scarcity at the watershed and season where they occur.
Publish uncertainty and stop calling gross avoided resin water a net saving.

tiers.name: eliminate_or_reuse_now
tiers.eligibility: Unnecessary, short-lived, leakage-prone uses with validated service alternatives
tiers.water_measurement: Meter replacement-system production and washing; count product loss and sanitation.

tiers.name: scale_reuse_and_high_capture
tiers.eligibility: Standardizable products with frequent turns and recoverable logistics
tiers.water_measurement: Report liters per completed service and break-even reuse count, not liters per container.

tiers.name: hazard_and_exposure_substitution
tiers.eligibility: Credible chemical or particle exposure with safer functionally validated alternatives
tiers.water_measurement: Include replacement chemical synthesis and wastewater toxicity, not volume alone.

tiers.name: application_specific_transition
tiers.eligibility: Long-lived infrastructure, medical, electrical, insulation, and food-preservation uses
tiers.water_measurement: Use lifetime service, leakage or energy performance, failure risk, and replacement interval.

modeled_global_policy_context_not_us_for.note: The remaining modeled reduction includes elimination of problematic and unnecessary uses and system changes. Values are a global UNEP roadmap, not additive U.S. statutory targets.

water_accounting_protocol.baseline: Current product-service system with virgin/recycled resin shares, loss, transport, and end of life
water_accounting_protocol.counterfactual: Specified prevention, reuse, recycling, or substitute system
functional_unit_examples: 1,000 liters of beverage delivered and consumed
one square meter of insulation meeting thermal and fire requirements for 50 years
water_accounting_protocol.national_estimate_gate: Do not publish a national net water-saving total until at least the dominant replacement systems have harmonized functional-unit inventories and geographically resolved adoption volumes.

minimum_dashboard_kpis: virgin resin avoided by resin and application
completed reuse turns and return rate
gross avoided cradle-to-resin water with range
modeled net water by watershed and scarcity class
priority chemical releases and worker exposure
stop_conditions: no end-of-life route for a claimed compostable
water burden shifted into a highly stressed basin
return rate below modeled reuse break-even
